dedupe_keys.name: emergency department admissions at a large teaching hospital in isfahan iran 143 582 de identified ed stays with triage admission and services tables 2017 2022

description: This database records every stay in the emergency department of a large university hospital in Isfahan, Iran, over five years, from the moment of triage to discharge, transfer or death. The producers are Zohreh BaniHassan, MohammadReza Kazemi, Majid Jangi and Hamed Tabesh, who extracted, cleaned and de-identified the hospital's electronic health records and described them in Data in Brief in 2024. Coverage runs from March 2017 to March 2022 and includes 143,582 stays, about a third of which arrived through pre-hospital emergency services, with the COVID-19 surge visible among chief complaints. Three linked tables hold triage vital signs and urgency grades, admission type, insurance, discharge status and length of stay, and the individual services delivered during each stay. The tables are available as a free download from Mendeley Data under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: a single hospital, exact dates reduced to year, month and weekday fields in triage, and clinical coding that needs the table description document to interpret. Simulation uses: calibrating arrival patterns, triage mix and length-of-stay distributions in emergency department queueing and surge capacity models, including pandemic stress. Related records: the AKTIN emergency department length-of-stay data (data-aktin-emergency-department-length-of-stay) give a German multi-hospital comparison.

discovery_routes.query: Open-access dataset of emergency department admissions, Isfahan teaching hospital (Data in Brief)

name: Emergency department admissions at a large teaching hospital in Isfahan, Iran: 143,582 de-identified ED stays with triage, admission and services tables (2017-2022)
provider: Zohreh BaniHassan, MohammadReza Kazemi, Majid Jangi and Hamed Tabesh (Mashhad University of Medical Sciences, Payame Noor University, Isfahan University of Medical Sciences)
schema_summary: Three linked tables keyed by triage_code, PatientCode, enter_time and ResidentDate: ED_triage (28 columns: chief complaint, vital signs, triage grade, admission year, month, day and weekday), ED_admission (admission type such as pre-hospital emergency, insurance, discharge status, length of stay) and services (ten CSV parts of services delivered during the stay); table description document

sources.note: Mendeley Data 'An open-access dataset of emergency department admissions at a large teaching hospital in Iran', version 1, published 2023-11-10, CC BY 4.0; files ED_admission.csv (12.0 MB), ED_triage.csv (10.7 MB), services1-10.csv (about 10-17 MB each), Tables Descriptions.docx

Data in Brief 56, 110827 (2024), read via Europe PMC full text: 143,582 ED stays at the main university hospital in Isfahan, March 2017 to March 2022; triage 63.7 percent urgent; 36.2 percent arrived by pre-hospital emergency; LOS from under 6 hours to over 7 days; COVID-19 among the most common chief complaints; three tables ED_triage (28 columns), ED_admission and services; personal information removed

title_en: Emergency department admissions at a large teaching hospital in Isfahan, Iran: 143,582 de-identified ED stays with triage, admission and services tables (2017-2022)
